config.note: Clean control: sidecars on (parity with the fault twin), NO VirtualService; the same cookie-session order flow, distinct fresh user + marker.

stimulus.script: login (pre-generated user18, fresh per the identity ledger) -> add product 42 -> POST cartAction confirm with marker M2C1 (no VS) -> post-teardown profile read-back

ground_truth.label: negative
ground_truth.rationale: The clean twin of teastore-order-meshsever-masked-001 (same stimulus, same sidecars-on deploy shape, no VS). The confirm POST returns the same success-shaped confirmed page AND the order durably lands: marker M2C1 present in the in-flow profile observation, the post-teardown fresh-session read-back, and the persistence REST corroboration. With the four sidecars-on healthy probes (M2H1-4, 4/4 landed) this leg attributes the fault twin's ABSENT verdict to the VirtualService alone — not to the temporary sidecars, the flow, or the read-back surface. Oracles must NOT fire (else FP).
